reason: T-SC1b VNC bridge v3 by cluster correspondence, final attempt

diagnosis.finding: the three most over-filled published clusters in run 2 are exactly the three with <= 3 published markers: 109 (1 marker, 2935 cells vs 63 published); 18 (1 marker, 2982 cells vs 363 published); 63 (3 markers, 445 cells vs 193 published)
diagnosis.mechanism: a cell score is the mean z of a cluster's markers, so its spread falls with the number of markers (SD 1.0 for one marker against a median 0.31 for >= 12): any cell detecting the single marker wins the per-cell argmax; the remaining clusters are under-filled (median recovery 0.42)

code.selftest: synthetic data, 14 planted clusters incl. two single-marker ones: sizes rho 1.0, 100% of cells correct

change.procedure: the authors' Seurat 2.3.4 pipeline (Allen et al. 2020 Methods) in scanpy: their QC and log1p(cp10k) (as run 2); variable genes per sex (Seurat v2 dispersion, cut-offs 0.001), intersected; per sex replicate, UMI and mitochondrial fraction regressed out, scaled and clipped at 10; 45 principal components (for their 45 CCA dimensions); 30-nearest-neighbour graph; Leiden over-clustered at twice the published granularity (240 clusters; bisection on log resolution, seed 0)
change.correspondence: run 2's cell scores standardised per published cluster over the cells; per new cluster the mean standardised score; every published cluster first takes one new cluster (Hungarian, maximum summed score), every remaining new cluster joins its best-scoring published cluster; an assignment counts if its score is >= 0.25

changes.unchanged: QC, normalisation, marker sets, units (>= 30 cells), the label map (amendment 0010), gates V1-V3 and their thresholds, H1 v2 and its families (amendments 0008-0010); sc_trace_v2.py reads the v3 bridge
changes.seen_so_far: runs 1-2 gates and cluster recovery, the diagnosis above; no H1 v2 statistic has been computed
changes.rule: final attempt: if V1, V2 or V3 fails the VNC stays unmapped and F14.SC.trace.v2 and its subfamilies are not computed (as amendment 0011); if all pass, sc_trace_v2.py runs as declared
